Interface PriceCandleRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<PriceCandle>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>
public interface PriceCandleRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<PriceCandle, PriceCandle.Key>
Interface to represent the repository for OHLC price candles in the market data system. This repository provides methods to perform CRUD operations and custom queries on candles.

  • Method Details

    • findByInstrument_SymbolAndBucketSecondsAndBucketStartBetweenOrderByBucketStartDesc

      org.springframework.data.domain.Page<PriceCandle> findByInstrument_SymbolAndBucketSecondsAndBucketStartBetweenOrderByBucketStartDesc(String symbol, int bucketSeconds, OffsetDateTime from, OffsetDateTime to, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Finds a newest-first page of candles for the given instrument symbol whose bucket falls within the given time range, at one bucket width. Callers always pin the width: the table holds several widths for the same instant, so an unfiltered range query would interleave 60s candles with the 1h and 1d rollups covering the same period.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the instrument symbol
      bucketSeconds - the bucket width, in seconds, to return
      from - the start of the time range, inclusive
      to - the end of the time range, inclusive
      pageable - the page and size to retrieve
      Returns:
      the matching page of candles, newest first

    • findNewest

      default Optional<PriceCandle> findNewest(String symbol, Collection<Integer> bucketSeconds)
      Returns the most recent candle for the given symbol across the given bucket widths. Used to resume the simulation from where it left off instead of restarting at the instrument's seed price, which would put a discontinuity in the price series at every application restart. Ties on bucket start are broken towards the narrowest bucket, whose close is the latest price in that instant.

      Asks for each width's newest candle separately: the primary key leads with the width after the instrument, so "newest at any width" as one query would read every candle the instrument has.

      Parameters:
      symbol - the instrument symbol
      bucketSeconds - the bucket widths to consider
      Returns:
      the newest candle for the symbol, or empty if it has none yet

    • existsByInstrument_InstrumentId

      boolean existsByInstrument_InstrumentId(UUID instrumentId)
      Reports whether any candle already exists for the given instrument, at any bucket width. Backs the historical backfill's idempotency check.
      Parameters:
      instrumentId - the instrument to check
      Returns:
      true if the instrument already has at least one candle

    • deleteByBucketSecondsAndBucketStartBefore

      @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM PriceCandle c WHERE c.bucketSeconds = :bucketSeconds AND c.bucketStart < :cutoff") int deleteByBucketSecondsAndBucketStartBefore(@Param("bucketSeconds") int bucketSeconds, @Param("cutoff") OffsetDateTime cutoff)
      Deletes every candle of one width older than a cutoff, in a single statement. Written as a bulk @Modifying query rather than a derived deleteBy..., which would load each row as an entity and delete it individually - the opposite of what a prune needs.
      Parameters:
      bucketSeconds - the bucket width to prune
      cutoff - candles whose bucket starts strictly before this are deleted
      Returns:
      the number of candles deleted
